result.title: CLiS: Plug-and-Play Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion on TPUs via Certified Stabilization
result.summary: High-resolution video diffusion relies on attention over long token sequences, making attention efficiency critical to generation latency. Our analysis identifies repeated maximum reductions and accumulator rescaling in online softmax as a bottleneck in long-context TPU attention. We propose CLiS (Certified Loop-invariant Stabilization), a training-free, plug-and-play optimization for video diffusion inference. CLiS fixes per-row stabilizers before the KV loop and certifies numerical safety per head, falling back to online softmax when certification fails. It integrates into existing fused-attention kernels without changing model weights or architecture. On Wan 2.2 and LTX-2 across TPU v6e and TPU7x, CLiS reduces diffusion transformer (DiT) step latency by up to 19.6% relative to tuned online softmax without measurable quality loss. Controlled TPU adaptations of prior GPU stabilization methods show performance or numerical-safety limitations. Preliminary causal LLM experiments also show up to 13.5% higher training throughput in continued pretraining and 7.7% in supervised fine-tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CLiS，一种免训练、即插即用的视频扩散注意力优化：在 KV 循环前固定每行稳定化量，并按 head 验证数值安全、失败时回退到 online softmax，从而降低 TPU 上的 DiT 单步延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 属视频生成的长序列注意力核实现与延迟优化，「certified」仅指 softmax 数值稳定性而非推理状态或证据使用的正确性，未涉及 latent 表示、推理状态更新、停止决策或监督，与 LVR 主线无实质联系。
